name: @self-learn/tutor
//: No build step, same as @self-learn/schema: the consumers are other workspaces running through tsx or vitest, and the Next app, which transpiles workspace packages itself. The two entries are split on purpose: "." holds only pure modules a client component can import (no Postgres, no node:crypto, nothing request-bound), and "./server" holds the database- and environment-bound reads the API routes and the sidecar share.
